ValidationRule.description: Set Reason Closed if Stage = Offer(s) Not Accepted
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Offer(s) Not Accepted"), ISPICKVAL( Reason_Closed__c, "" ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You must enter a Reason if Stage set to Offer(s) Not Accepted. Please check the field Reason Closed.
